template: On the Grafana dashboard '{{v1}}' (at /d/{{v3}}/{{v4}}), set the dashboard's time range to 'Last 6 hours' using the time picker in the top bar (click the time range button, choose the 'Last 6 hours' quick range). Then click the Save dashboard button, and in the Save dashboard dialog TICK the checkbox labelled 'Update default time range' (so the time range is persisted into the saved dashboard), then click Save. Verify the save succeeded. Then reload the page fresh and report what time range the dashboard shows by default after the reload.

reportTemplate.summary: Set the time picker to the 'Last 6 hours' quick range, clicked Save dashboard, ticked 'Update default time range' (which enabled the previously-disabled Save button) and saved. Save succeeded: the dashboard version incremented to 4 and the dashboard's own JSON (Settings > JSON Model) now contains "time": {"from": "now-6h", "to": "now"}. After a fresh reload of /d/{{v3}}/{{v4}} (no time params in the URL) the dashboard defaults to "Last 6 hours" (URL resolves to from=now-6h&to=now), and both panels ('{{v2}} Notes', '{{v2}} Availability') are still present.
